import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class TextDocumentAnalysis {
    static int countInsideBraces = 0, longestWord = 0;

    public static int removeUnderscore(String str) {
        str = str.replaceAll("_", " ");
        str = str.trim().replaceAll(" +", " ");
        String[] tokens = str.split(" ");
        if (tokens.length == 1 && tokens[0].equals(""))
            return 0;
        return tokens.length;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        String s = scanner.next();
        List<Integer> braceIndices = new ArrayList<>();
        braceIndices.add(-1);
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == '(' || s.charAt(i) == ')') {
                braceIndices.add(i);
            }
        }
        int i = 1, count = 0, maxWordLength = 0;
        String outsideBraces = "";
        while (i < braceIndices.size() - 1) {
            int openIdx = braceIndices.get(i);
            int closeIdx = braceIndices.get(i + 1);
            String inside = s.substring(openIdx + 1, closeIdx);
            count = removeUnderscore(inside);
            countInsideBraces += count;
            outsideBraces += "_" + s.substring(braceIndices.get(i - 1) + 1, openIdx);
            i += 2;
        }
        outsideBraces += "_" + s.substring(braceIndices.get(braceIndices.size() - 1) + 1);
        outsideBraces = outsideBraces.replaceAll("_", " ");
        outsideBraces = outsideBraces.trim().replaceAll(" +", " ");
        String[] words = outsideBraces.split(" ");
        for (String word : words) {
            if (word.length() > maxWordLength)
                maxWordLength = word.length();
        }
        System.out.print(maxWordLength + " " + countInsideBraces);
    }
}
